evals.prompt: Build me a sortable data table showing a list of users with columns: Name, Email, Role, Last Active. I want to click column headers to sort.
evals.expected_output: React component with useState for sort state, onClick on th elements, aria-sort attributes, sort indicator icons.
expectations: Uses useState for sort key and direction
Has onClick handler on <th> elements for sorting
Includes aria-sort attribute on the active sort column
Shows sort indicator icon (arrow-up/arrow-down or similar)

evals.prompt: Create a paginated table for displaying product inventory. Show 10 items per page with navigation controls.
evals.expected_output: Table with page state, page-size controls, Showing X-Y of Z text, prev/next navigation.
expectations: Shows 'Showing X-Y of Z' pagination info
Slices data based on current page and page size

evals.prompt: Build a stats dashboard with 4 metric cards showing: Total Revenue, Active Users, Conversion Rate, and Average Order Value. Use proper formatting.
evals.expected_output: Grid layout with stat cards using FormatNumber/FormatBytes components, Badge for trends.
expectations: Uses wa-grid or similar grid layout
Uses FormatNumber component for currency/number formatting
